name: Capecitabine (single-agent fluoropyrimidine, reduced-intensity / maintenance anal SCC)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.histology: squamous cell carcinoma of the anus
biomarkers.note: Single-agent oral capecitabine is a reduced-intensity fluoropyrimidine option for frail patients unfit for a platinum doublet, and a convenient maintenance fluoropyrimidine for durable responders. DPYD testing advised before starting. General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.

premedications.name: None routine
premedications.notes: Oral therapy; counsel on hand-foot syndrome, diarrhea, and adherence.

supportiveCare: Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 PO twice daily on days 1 to 14 of a 21-day cycle (sourced monotherapy range 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 twice daily); continue until progression or intolerance.
Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing before starting (FDA boxed warning).
Prioritise symptom control and quality of life; dose-attenuate readily for frailty.
monitoring: CBC and renal/hepatic function before each cycle
hand-foot syndrome and diarrhea assessment each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2+ hand-foot syndrome, diarrhea, or renal impairment
doseModificationRules.text: Hold until recovery then reduce dose per labeling; reduce starting dose for moderate renal impairment. Clinical review required.
Reduce dose or avoid capecitabine in DPYD-deficient patients per FDA boxed warning; clinical review required.

drugs.name: Capecitabine
drugs.notes: Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 PO twice daily on days 1 to 14 of a 21-day cycle; dosePerUnit is the lower bound of the sourced monotherapy range 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 twice daily. DPYD testing advised before starting (FDA boxed warning). General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.
